answer: Identity is not a title deed here; it is a flame needing fuel. Each epoch of genuine activity accrues a liveness credit, but silence burns that credit like a cedar log, and once it spirals to nothing the wallet is newborn again, forced to re-earn weight through real work. Pearl-like patina only gathers on hands that keep working. A Sybil orchard cannot park ten thousand husks and wait out the clock: dormancy is taxed, and re-waking each wallet costs a full liveness cycle, every cycle.
